pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with high edge angularity and sharp pixel gradients. Patches on the upper shoulder and neck exhibit star-like protrusions and high-frequency perimeter fluctuations, while mid-flank patches are larger in relative spatial area and more quadrangular.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: High-contrast, light-toned inter-patch pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Pathway thickness is moderate and relatively uniform across the mid-flank, with a slight increase in width towards the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency 1D jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck and shoulder. Individual hair tufts create a saw-toothed profile with variable amplitude against the background pixels.
